content.short: Noah AI is a no-code AI builder for full-stack onchain apps on Solana and Monad.
content.description: Noah AI generates web and mobile applications with on-chain functionality built in, aimed at developers who want a working dapp without assembling the stack. It publishes the set of networks a generated app can deploy to, Monad and Solana among them. Integrations cover the services a typical application needs alongside contract interaction.
content.meta: Generates full-stack onchain applications for Solana and Monad from a prompt.
